Title: Scope growth
Description: Attempting advanced Painter features before the mesh-to-export loop is dependable
Mitigation: Deliver and verify roadmap milestones in order

Title: Channel-blind compositing
Description: Using color blending for scalar or normal data can corrupt material output
Mitigation: Define channel-specific compositing contracts and tests before implementing the compositor

Title: Untrusted project data
Description: Malformed files or oversized dimensions could cause invalid state or excessive allocation
Mitigation: Validate schema and bound resource sizes before allocation or rendering

Title: Triangle-indexed polygon masks
Description: Polygon masks reference triangle indices so reimporting a changed mesh silently re-targets or drops selections
Mitigation: Remap across subdivision levels now; add stable face identities or reprojection before mesh replacement lands

Title: Bake cost on dense meshes
Description: Mesh-map raycasting and generator compositing scale with texels and triangles and can stall interactive iteration
Mitigation: Background cancellable mesh-map bakes; multi-threaded generator evaluation; add tiled dirty-region compositing before 4K+ texture sets
